name: Execute loop-failed → stamp counter on RUN loop (per-C1 fix)
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack — iteration JOIN counter, loop-failed half. Fires when an autoresearch-execute loop terminates with outcome=failed — the loop itself crashed BEFORE emitting decide(action=measured). Causes: sandbox bash dispatch timed out, agentic-loop hit max_iterations without decide, container OOM mid-bash, NATS transient failure dropped the loop, panic in the LLM completion path.

Writes the same autoresearch.experiment.completed triple onto the RUN loop entity that rule 04a writes. Together 04a + 04b implement the README's 'honest accounting of the iteration budget' claim: every execute consumes one budget slot regardless of whether the measurement completed cleanly OR the loop crashed mid-iteration. Failed executes still cost an iteration; the chain still makes forward progress against the cap.

Review-fix rationale (2026-05-29): the original single rule 04 conditioned on outcome=success+decide=measured. A failed execute would NOT increment the counter; rule 11 (loop-failed-pause) would stamp chain.paused.marker and the chain would wedge silently while the counter showed N-1 rather than N. The fix routes loop-failed executes through this rule (counter increments, chain continues) and removes autoresearch-execute from rule 11's role list (no more pause-on-execute-fail).

For propose / synthesize / baseline / reviewer-autoresearch failures, rule 11 still pauses the chain — those failures DO need operator intervention; only execute failures are budgeted-and-continue.

metadata.two_triples_rationale: Stamps both autoresearch.experiment.completed (for the cap counter — same predicate as 04a's stamp, dedup-safe via the per-(subject,predicate,object) set semantics) AND autoresearch.experiment.loop-failed (for the SYNTHESIZE rollup to distinguish loop-failed iterations from cleanly-measured ones — the former are budget-consumed but evidence-empty; reviewer-autoresearch grades the journey including any loop-failures as 'iterations that consumed budget without producing measurement data').
metadata.no_outcome_triple_caveat: A loop-failed execute has NOT called emit_autoresearch_measurement. There is no autoresearch.measurement.value, .pass, .outcome on the failed execute's loop entity. SYNTHESIZE iterates the journal via $entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.triples and read_loop_result on each; for loop-failed entries, read_loop_result returns an empty/partial result. The synthesize persona MUST handle this gracefully — count the iteration but mark it 'loop-failed (no measurement)' in the journey. The reviewer-autoresearch persona's checklist includes 'all loop-failed iterations are accounted for in the journey'.
metadata.review_fix_origin: Per reviewer C1 (2026-05-29). Without this rule, a failed execute would silently wedge the chain (rule 11 pause + counter stuck at N-1). With this rule + the rule 11 autoresearch-execute removal, the cap budget honestly bounds iterations including failures.
